title: Preset foundation
description: Preview settings, then copy selected changes into your local edits. Save draft when ready.
meteredHint: Bind a live power measurement and a named output action to the same Modbus point to use this preset.
digitalHint: Add a digital {{direction}} or a compatible Modbus output to use this preset.
copy: Copy selected changes to local edits

metered-switched-load.name: Metered switched load
metered-switched-load.description: Switches an output off immediately when disconnected and reports a transformed measurement.

pulsed-lock-bank.name: Pulsed lock bank
pulsed-lock-bank.description: Pulses an output briefly and returns it to off immediately when disconnected.

guarded-enable-request.name: Guarded enable request
guarded-enable-request.description: Makes a non-safety enable request only while an operational guard is satisfied.
